Entire Acquisition Proceedings Initiated By The
Respondents Vide Priliminary Notification
Dt.13.6.1989 As Per Ann-C & The Final Notification
Dt.6.12.1989 As Per Ann-D Issued By The R1 & R3 In
Respect Of The Land Bearing Sy.No.73, Measuring
3-Acres, 29-Guntas Of Shettihalli Village, Tumkur
Taluk Is Lapsed In View Of Section 24(2) Of Right To
Fair Compensation & Transparency In Land
Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act 2013 &
Grant All The Consequential Reliefs And Etc.
 This Writ Petition Coming On For Orders This
Day

sentences.text: 3. Sri. T. P. Vivekananda, learned counsel for the respondent - Authority submits that even on merits, petitioner has no case as the petitioner has not demonstrated that he possesses title to the land in question.

It is further submitted that even if the petitioner were to make out a case seeking lapse under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the cumulative conditions regarding taking over possession as well as payment of compensation have to be satisfied and in the present case, it is not in dispute that in terms of Annexure-R9, possession of the property in Sy. No.73 has been taken over on 11.03.1991 itself.
4. Noticing the lack of diligence in prosecuting the proceedings, the petition is dismissed for non- prosecution, while clarifying that there is no adjudication on merits.
Sd/-
